title: Strategy Inc August 17, 2026 Form 8-K treasury update
excerpt: As of August 16, Strategy reported 840,447 bitcoin, a USD 4.80 billion reserve, 3,458,866 MSTR shares sold and 1,388,720 STRC shares repurchased during the week.
summary: The filing updates Strategy's treasury and financing state through August 16, including common issuance, no weekly Bitcoin trade, STRC repurchases and reserve growth.
